Removed "People commonly believe the lavender candle burns for 10 hours." — it says something about the reader's own order or booking, and nothing here knows who is reading it.

Removed "These candles are not 10-hour candles, contrary to what people commonly believe." — Fact states candles have 40 hour burn time, but does not address what people commonly believe or contradict 10-hour claims..

Removed "Shree Dairy offers fresh morning paneer." — Record shows 'Paneer 250g: Made fresh every morning' but no fact links this to Shree Dairy's offerings; the paneer record does not cover this claim per scope rules..
